meta.title: Coach Jeremy Christensen | Football Coaching — Minnesota
meta.description: Professional football coaching at Minnewaska Area HS. Offensive expertise, personalized training, and real results.

about.name: Coach Jeremy Christensen
about.title: OC, former HC
about.bio:
Coach Jeremy Christensen brings 18 years of experience running the Wing-T system at Minnewaska Area HS. With a sharp offensive mind and a track record of developing athletes who perform at the next level, Coach Christensen is known for making practice reps count. Works with athletes at the College level.

From route running to pre-snap reads to protection schemes — Coach Christensen delivers the kind of coaching that shows up in the box score.

hero.headline: Minnewaska Area HS's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized offensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: Wing-T System Coaching
services.description: Installation and development of the Wing-T offense — from core concepts to advanced adjustments that put defenses in conflict.

services.title: Skill Position Development
services.description: Individual coaching for QBs, WRs, RBs, and TEs focused on technique, route running, footwork, and pre-snap reads.

services.title: Offensive Playbook & Film Study
services.description: Playbook design tailored to your personnel, plus film sessions that sharpen in-game decision making for players and staff.
